subject: SableTech MSA & Order form — template choice, payer details, and redline plan
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@sabletech.com>

Cc: procurement@sabletech.com, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@sabletech.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MSA + Order form for SableTech (PO attached)

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Attached is our PO and a first-pass redline of Redwood's MSA (we annotated comments in the document). A few things to flag up front:

- We need Net 45 payment terms reflected on the Order Form.
- Our legal team prefers to preserve data residency commitments in Exhibit B.
- We scoped the initial usage on the Order Form (see spreadsheet).

For timeline: procurement is hoping to get counters back within 5 business days so we can route to finance for payment. Can you confirm who on Redwood will own the redlines and whether you accept our redline format?

Attachments: [SableTech_PO_9876.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)], [SableTech_MSA_redlines.docx (Word, 38 KB)], [OrderForm_Specs.xlsx (Excel, 14 KB)]

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Director, Procurement | SableTech

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order form for SableTech (PO attached)

Elena —

Appreciate the materials and the clear scope. Quick notes and plan:

1) We received the PO and redline doc. Laura (contracts) will lead redline coordination; Karthis (legal) will review high-risk clauses.
2) Net 45 on the Order Form is a commercial ask — I’ll loop finance if we need collection terms exceptions.
3) Data residency requests on Exhibit B look feasible; we’ll confirm acceptable regions and any cost impact.

Karthik / Laura — can you take point on the redline review? Prefer we return a consolidated marked-up Word with comments and a short summary of any nonstandard asks. Can you aim to produce the first pass by next Thu (11/26)? That keeps SableTech’s 5-business-day window intact.

Elena — I’ll set up a short 30-min sync early next week if helpful (holds: Mon 11/23 09:00–09:30 PT).

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Lead | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order form for SableTech (PO attached)

Thanks — I’ll triage the redline set this afternoon. Early impressions:

- Payment term (Net 45) is unusual for our Standard Order Form; need to confirm with finance whether we can accept as-is or require a payment plan.
- Several liability cap and indemnity edits look material (¶7–9). I’ll annotate each proposed change with risk level and recommended counter language.
- Data residency asks are narrow but may require Exhibit B variant; Laura, can you confirm the template we keep for EU/US/Apac locality?

Deliverables: marked-up Word (tracked changes) + a 1-pager summary of escalations/recommendations. ETA: 11/26 COB for the first pass; if anything pops as urgent I’ll flag earlier.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Dylan / team —

Thanks for the quick acknowledgement. A couple follow-ups:

- The PO needs a billing contact and remittance address on your side for our AP team. Can you confirm who will be listed and the invoice email?
- We can be flexible on payment terms if you provide an invoice cadence that supports Net 30/45 — willing to accept milestone invoicing.

If a short sync helps, Marco and I can join Tuesday morning PT.

Best,
Elena

- Billing / remittance: invoices@redwood-inference.com. Redwood Finance (AP) processes Net 30 by default; we can propose Net 45 for this customer but will call out on the summary if exception is required.
- Signer: Standard signing authority is VP Business Ops; I’ll confirm the signer name and provide a signer matrix in the next update.

Plan: Karthik will annotate risk items; I’ll fold those into the Word doc and return a consolidated redline + a one-page escalation summary by Thu 11/26. If you want a Tue sync, Dylan — please put up the invite and I’ll join.
